brief: account and workspace settings for a team product

defects.what: Decorative 157px hero banner with orbit rings repeats the title and pushes the form down
Danger zone is a peer of routine sections in the nav
42px title outweighs the fields people came to change; a rare avatar action gets a full panel
Saving split across a panel button, a floating bar and a status label with different wording
Active nav item marked four ways; decorative label styling and tile
On phone, 38px-high 12px tabs in a 3x2 grid take the first screen
Much supporting text is 10-12px muted grey; low-contrast footer
Picker opens above its trigger and covers the field label and other inputs
About 400 ungrouped zone names with no offsets; five rows visible
Roles listed without what they can do; current role marked twice
Does not say what happens to the person's content, whether it can be undone, or billing; red trash always visible per row
Copy understates a permanent deletion; button looks active before the name is typed
Toast covers the Save button just clicked, at both widths
Roles unexplained, jargon copy, unclear if an email is sent or a seat billed; dark radios look disabled

reviewer: Claude Sonnet, blind review of screenshots and source (never saw the rule list)

removed.why: Artifact of the harness: the surface was opened with a scripted click from a hidden section or at a fixed point, so its position is not what a person would see.
